name: Ren'Ai Kumikyoku
source:
Hero gets into an all-girl school band as a result of the injury of sempai. He is responsible for the keyboard and there is a rhythm minigame introduced to measure his success.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
前辈受伤后，主人公因此加入了一支女子学校乐队。他负责演奏键盘，游戏中还设有节奏小游戏，用以衡量他的表现。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
